mapper.sql: SELECT dp.MEDICAL_NUMBER AS medicalNumber, pm.MEMBER_NAME AS patientName, pm.RESIDENT_REGISTRATION_NUMBER AS residentNumber, dm.MEMBER_NAME AS employeeName, dept.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS deptName, TO_CHAR(MIN(dp.PRESCRIPTION_DATE), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS prescriptionDate, TO_CHAR(MAX(dp.DISPENSE_COMPLETED_DATE), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS dispenseCompletedDate, MAX(dp.PRESCRIPTION_STATUS) AS prescriptionStatus, ( SELECT cm2.CODENAME_1 FROM DOCTOR_PRESCRIPTION dp2 JOIN MEDICINE m2 ON dp2.MEDICINE_CODE = m2.MEDICINE_CODE JOIN COMMONCODE cm2 ON m2.MEDICINE_NAME = cm2.COMMONCODE_NUMBER AND cm2.COMMONCODE = 'M' WHERE dp2.MEDICAL_NUMBER = dp.MEDICAL_NUMBER AND ROWNUM = 1 ) || CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 1 THEN ' 외 ' || (COUNT(*) - 1) || '건' ELSE '' END AS orderName, ( SELECT cc2.CODENAME_2 FROM DOCTOR_PRESCRIPTION dp3 JOIN MEDICINE m3 ON dp3.MEDICINE_CODE = m3.MEDICINE_CODE JOIN COMMONCODE cc2 ON m3.MEDICINE_CATEGORY = cc2.COMMONCODE_NUMBER AND cc2.COMMONCODE = 'C' WHERE dp3.MEDICAL_NUMBER = dp.MEDICAL_NUMBER AND ROWNUM = 1 ) AS medicineRoute FROM DOCTOR_PRESCRIPTION dp JOIN RECEPTIONIST_REGISTER rr ON dp.MEDICAL_NUMBER = rr.MEDICAL_NUMBER JOIN MEMBER pm ON rr.MEMBER_NUMBER = pm.MEMBER_NUMBER JOIN MEMBER dm ON rr.DOCTOR_NUMBER = dm.MEMBER_NUMBER LEFT JOIN EMPLOYEE emp ON rr.DOCTOR_NUMBER = emp.MEMBER_NUMBER LEFT JOIN DEPARTMENT dept ON emp.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dept.DEPARTMENT_CODE
mapper.select: WHERE dp.PRESCRIPTION_STATUS = 'N' GROUP BY dp.MEDICAL_NUMBER , pm.MEMBER_NAME , pm.RESIDENT_REGISTRATION_NUMBER , dm.MEMBER_NAME , dept.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY MIN(dp.PRESCRIPTION_DATE) ASC
WHERE dp.PRESCRIPTION_STATUS = 'Y' GROUP BY dp.MEDICAL_NUMBER , pm.MEMBER_NAME , pm.RESIDENT_REGISTRATION_NUMBER , dm.MEMBER_NAME , dept.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY MIN(dp.PRESCRIPTION_DATE) DESC
mapper.sql: SELECT dp.MEDICAL_NUMBER AS medicalNumber, dp.MEDICINE_CODE AS medicineCode, cm.CODENAME_1 AS medicineName, cc.CODENAME_1 AS medicineCategoryName, cc.CODENAME_2 AS medicineRoute, TO_CHAR(dp.DISPENSE_COMPLETED_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS dispenseCompletedDate, m.CURRENT_QUANTITY AS currentQuantity, m.MIN_QUANTITY AS minQuantity, dp.TOTAL_QTY AS totalQty, dp.FREQUENCY AS frequency, dp.NUMBER_OF_DAYS_ADMINISTERED AS numberOfDaysAdministered, dp.PRESCRIPTION_STATUS AS prescriptionStatus FROM DOCTOR_PRESCRIPTION dp JOIN MEDICINE m ON dp.MEDICINE_CODE = m.MEDICINE_CODE LEFT JOIN COMMONCODE cm ON m.MEDICINE_NAME = cm.COMMONCODE_NUMBER AND cm.COMMONCODE = 'M' LEFT JOIN COMMONCODE cc ON m.MEDICINE_CATEGORY = cc.COMMONCODE_NUMBER AND cc.COMMONCODE = 'C'
mapper.update: UPDATE MEDICINE m SET m.CURRENT_QUANTITY = m.CURRENT_QUANTITY - ( SELECT NVL(SUM(dp.TOTAL_QTY), 0) FROM DOCTOR_PRESCRIPTION dp WHERE dp.MEDICAL_NUMBER = #{medicalNumber} AND dp.MEDICINE_CODE = m.MEDICINE_CODE AND dp.PRESCRIPTION_STATUS = 'N' ) WHERE m.MEDICINE_CODE IN ( SELECT dp2.MEDICINE_CODE FROM DOCTOR_PRESCRIPTION dp2 WHERE dp2.MEDICAL_NUMBER = #{medicalNumber} AND dp2.PRESCRIPTION_STATUS = 'N' )
UPDATE DOCTOR_PRESCRIPTION SET PRESCRIPTION_STATUS = 'Y', DISPENSE_COMPLETED_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE MEDICAL_NUMBER = #{medicalNumber} AND PRESCRIPTION_STATUS = 'N'
